content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer, brushing my shoulder against his ||| "What if I say something they won't expect?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, pulling my hand away from his ||| "I can't answer that here, not in front of them."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, my voice low and trembling ||| "I don't want to disappoint you, but I feel lost."  
REVERSAL ||| Take the blade from his hand, my grip firm ||| "I will decide what truth I reveal here, not you."  
SILENCE ||| Hold my breath, staring at the blade in my palm |||
